reason: A browser-reading plugin for DeepSeek Harness that opens allowlisted web pages through CDP and returns visible page text with selector, wait-time, and length controls.

summaries.zh: 通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 打开白名单网页并返回可见正文，支持 CSS 选择器、等待时间和返回长度配置。
summaries.en: Reads visible text from allowlisted web pages through Chrome DevTools Protocol with CSS selector, wait-time, and output-length controls.

capabilities: Opens HTTP and HTTPS pages through Chrome DevTools Protocol
Reads visible page text from allowlisted hosts
Can read content from authenticated sites in the dedicated Chrome session
Supports CSS selector filtering and configurable wait and character limits
